description: Invented Japanese sentences with reference English translations, written for this repo (no third-party text). Eight per category: keigo, omission (dropped subjects/objects, resolved by a second clause), idiom, counter, onomatopoeia. Scored by tools/translate-eval.cjs with chrF; alternate references cover legitimate variation.

items.source: 先生は明日の会議にいらっしゃいますか。
references: Will the professor be coming to tomorrow's meeting?
Will you be attending tomorrow's meeting, Professor?

items.source: 資料は後ほどメールでお送りいたします。
references: I will send you the materials by email later.
We will email you the documents shortly.

items.source: 少々お待ちくださいませ。
references: Please wait a moment.
One moment, please.

items.source: 社長がそうおっしゃっていました。
references: The president said so.
That is what the company president said.

items.source: お名前を伺ってもよろしいでしょうか。
references: May I ask your name?
Could I have your name, please?

items.source: このたびはご迷惑をおかけして、誠に申し訳ございません。
references: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience we have caused.
We are truly sorry for the trouble we have caused you.

items.source: 部長はもうお帰りになりました。
references: The manager has already gone home.
The department head has already left for the day.

items.source: 何かございましたら、お気軽にお申し付けください。
references: If there is anything you need, please feel free to let us know.
Please don't hesitate to ask if you need anything.

items.source: 田中さんに電話した？うん、でも出なかった。
references: Did you call Mr. Tanaka? Yes, but he didn't answer.
Did you call Tanaka? Yeah, but he didn't pick up.

items.source: このケーキ、食べてもいい？いいよ、全部どうぞ。
references: Can I eat this cake? Sure, have all of it.
Is it okay if I eat this cake? Go ahead, you can have the whole thing.

items.source: 宿題は終わった？まだ半分しかやってない。
references: Have you finished your homework? I've only done half of it so far.
Did you finish your homework? I've only done half so far.

items.source: 妹は犬が大好きで、毎朝散歩に連れていく。
references: My younger sister loves dogs and takes hers for a walk every morning.
My little sister loves dogs, and she takes the dog for a walk every morning.

items.source: 財布を忘れたので、取りに戻った。
references: I forgot my wallet, so I went back to get it.
I left my wallet behind, so I went back for it.

items.source: 新しい本を買ったけど、まだ読んでいない。
references: I bought a new book, but I haven't read it yet.

items.source: 駅に着いたら連絡して。
references: Let me know when you get to the station.
Contact me when you arrive at the station.

items.source: 手紙をもらったけど、誰からか分からない。
references: I got a letter, but I don't know who it's from.
I received a letter, but I don't know who sent it.

items.source: 彼は顔が広いので、誰でも紹介してくれる。
references: He knows a lot of people, so he can introduce you to anyone.
He is well connected, so he will introduce you to anybody.

items.source: 試験の結果を聞いて、胸をなでおろした。
references: I was relieved when I heard the exam results.
Hearing the results of the exam, I breathed a sigh of relief.

items.source: あの二人は犬猿の仲だ。
references: Those two can't stand each other.
Those two fight like cats and dogs.

items.source: 猫の手も借りたいほど忙しい。
references: I'm so busy I'd take any help I can get.
We are so busy we could use all the help we can get.

items.source: 彼女は口が堅いから、秘密を話しても大丈夫だ。
references: She can keep a secret, so it's safe to tell her.
She is tight-lipped, so you can tell her the secret.

items.source: 部長の話は耳にたこができるほど聞いた。
references: I've heard the manager's story so many times I'm sick of it.
I've heard the boss's talk so often I'm tired of hearing it.

items.source: 今さら後悔しても後の祭りだ。
references: It's too late to regret it now.
There's no point in regretting it now; it's too late.

items.source: 彼の冗談には腹を抱えて笑った。
references: I doubled over laughing at his joke.
His joke had me in stitches.

items.source: 机の上に鉛筆が三本ある。
references: There are three pencils on the desk.

items.source: 猫を二匹飼っています。
references: I have two cats.
I keep two cats.

items.source: 駅まで車で十五分かかります。
references: It takes fifteen minutes by car to get to the station.
It's a fifteen-minute drive to the station.

items.source: 紙を五枚ください。
references: Five sheets of paper, please.
Please give me five sheets of paper.

items.source: 昨日、本を四冊買った。
references: I bought four books yesterday.
Yesterday I bought four books.

items.source: この家には部屋が六つある。
references: This house has six rooms.
There are six rooms in this house.

items.source: 子どもが三人います。
references: I have three children.
I have three kids.

items.source: ビールを二杯飲んだ。
references: I drank two glasses of beer.
I had two beers.

items.source: 雨がざあざあ降っている。
references: It's pouring rain.
The rain is pouring down.

items.source: お腹がぺこぺこだ。
references: I'm starving.
I'm really hungry.

items.source: 赤ちゃんがすやすや眠っている。
references: The baby is sleeping peacefully.
The baby is sleeping soundly.

items.source: 緊張して胸がドキドキした。
references: I was nervous and my heart was pounding.
My heart was racing with nerves.

items.source: 彼は怒ってぷんぷんしている。
references: He is fuming with anger.
He's all huffy and angry.

items.source: 床がぴかぴかに磨かれている。
references: The floor has been polished until it shines.
The floor is polished to a shine.

items.source: 外は風がびゅうびゅう吹いている。
references: The wind is howling outside.
It's blowing hard outside.

items.source: 彼女はにこにこしながら手を振った。
references: She waved with a big smile.
She waved, smiling brightly.
